allocation_complete.reason: No allocates; scored max as the guide prescribes.

completeness.reason: Every covered requirement maps to a named responsibility with an arch part.

consistency.reason: Reconciled with SUB_BMS / SUB_ENG: VCU displays, limits and coordinates; they supply and actuate.

design_clarity.reason: States which responsibilities apply in which products and its own code base, but names no concrete choice at subsystem level (interfaces to BMS/ENG, instrument cluster, torque request path).
design_clarity.suggestion: Name the chosen interfaces, e.g. energy value from BMS/ENG, display output to the instrument cluster, torque request limiting.

implementability.reason: Bounded ECU subsystem with own code under src/vcu.

interface_only.reason: No allocates; scored max as the guide prescribes.

parent_fit.reason: Names a responsibility for every covered requirement: energy and range display, traction power limit, HV shutdown (bev), door interlock (bus).

variant_consistency.reason: Ungated platform element; bev/bus-only covers use variant functions and the body now ties HV shutdown to battery-electric products and the door interlock to buses.
